label: You do not have an ITIN. (Debtor 1)
why: Every filer must either list ITINs or tick this box. The ITINNum constant is empty and Check Box3 is an empty constant, so neither happens.

label: Your name, For Debtor 2
why: The schema targets the nonexistent Debtor2a.* names, so a joint filer's spouse is never named (DIG-64).

label: You do not have an ITIN. (Debtor 2)
why: Needed for joint filers; the schema binds only empty constants for Debtor 2 ITINs.

label: You do not have a Social Security number. (Debtor 1)
why: The no-SSN case is routed to Debtor 2's box (Check Box2) with a non-matching on_state, so a filer without an SSN gets no box ticked.

label: ITIN (Debtor 1)
why: Filers who use an ITIN have nowhere to enter it. The schema key "ITINNum" is an empty constant and, by short name, would hit both Debtor1a.ITINNum and Debtor1b.ITINNum.
